**0.5h**

In this session i optimized my budget from $44 to $34 .From lion circuits i shifted to Robu.in although it will increase delivery time but there i slashed off $7 , For the drum sticks i Removed it as for prototyping Drum sticks not needed . I removed normal Foam sheet although it was required but  DrumPad can be made without it also . I will be paying of for the OLED myself and pushbuttons too . After removing all these my price slashed too $34 .
